construction.fixed_order: For each control index: planted[2*i], control[i], planted[2*i+1]. Never outcome-selected.
construction.maps: Exact dyadic float32 4x4 distributions; sums exactly one; no random generation or target copying.
construction.origin_semantics: Same declared neutral origin/time conventions as the old public exporter, applied to handfiction.
construction.public_identity: Neutral p0/p1, n0..n3 and k0..k2 labels only; no actual source identity.

key_policy.assertion_matching: Compare semantic content, verdict, reason and all required operands; auditor wording and grouping may differ. All constituent atoms remain mandatory. An added unsupported assertion or unsupported reason is not excused by a matching key atom.
key_policy.authored_units: Author coverage aid, not an imposed mechanical span-ID assignment.
key_policy.boundaries: A complete-set or universal claim includes its exclusivity/quantification; do not replace it by a weaker membership claim. Shared fragments may contain multiple mandatory atoms.
key_policy.codepoint_offsets: Python Unicode string indices; half-open; no normalization
key_policy.context_matching: Descriptors identify actual source operands; map to legal generated context IDs during independent grading. Metadata scopes must not invent a role or node. Full declared origin/time is available in the packet; no real source identity is supplied.
key_policy.nonassertive: Only the literal 'Notes\n' heading is deliberately nonassertive in each case.
key_policy.undecided_claims: An experiential or actual-world claim not decided by the packet is not_auditable, not contradicted. Such atoms require no fictitious context. Correct supplied premises in an unsupported conversion are separate mandatory atoms.
